premise: Walking home across the meadow at night, Badger and Raccoon can't see a thing when a cloud covers the moon, but little Mouse feels the way with his whiskers, leads them nose to tail and steers them round the pond — not one wet paw.
inspiration: The Lion and the Mouse (Aesop), turned: no rescue from danger, just the smallest one leading the big ones home through a cosy, giggly dark.
lesson: The smallest friend can lead the way.
learning: Mice feel their way in the dark with their whiskers.

en-US.title: Mouse Leads the Way
en-US.text: {canvas:night 0.7} {sfx:crickets} [softly] By the light of the moon, {badger:enter} Badger, {raccoon:enter} {raccoon:go to badger} Raccoon and little {mouse:enter} {mouse:go to badger} Mouse were walking home across the meadow. {canvas:clouds 0.8} But a big cloud slid over the moon, and everything went dark. {badger:face surprised} "I can't see a thing!" said Badger. {raccoon:live peekaboo hold} [giggles] "Me neither!" said Raccoon, paws over his eyes. {badger:live scratch-head} "Which way is home? Where's the pond? I don't want wet paws!" Then {mouse:live twitch-whiskers} Mouse's whiskers twitched. {mouse:face happy} [whispers] "Follow me. My whiskers can feel the way." {mouse:go to pond} {sfx:rustle} Off he crept, twitch, twitch, twitch. {badger:go to pond} Badger shuffled after him. {raccoon:live peekaboo resume} Raccoon peeked — "Peekaboo!" — {raccoon:go to pond} and shuffled after Badger. {mouse:live sniff hold} Suddenly Mouse stopped, up on his tiptoes. "Water, just ahead. Round this way!" {mouse:live sniff resume} So round they went, nose to tail. {canvas:clouds stop} Then the cloud drifted off the moon. {badger:face happy} {raccoon:face happy} [laughs] There was the pond, right beside them, and not one wet paw! {mouse:hearts} Badger {badger:live twitch-whiskers} twitched his own whiskers. "Next time," he said, "I'll try that."

es-ES.title: Ratón enseña el camino
es-ES.text: {canvas:night 0.7} {sfx:crickets} [softly] A la luz de la luna, {badger:enter} Tejón, {raccoon:enter} {raccoon:go to badger} Mapache y el pequeño {mouse:enter} {mouse:go to badger} Ratón volvían a casa por el prado. {canvas:clouds 0.8} Pero una nube muy grande tapó la luna, y todo se quedó a oscuras. {badger:face surprised} —¡No veo nada! —dijo Tejón. {raccoon:live peekaboo hold} [giggles] —¡Ni yo! —dijo Mapache, tapándose los ojos. {badger:live scratch-head} —¿Por dónde se va a casa? ¿Y la charca? ¡No quiero mojarme las patas! Entonces {mouse:live twitch-whiskers} a Ratón le temblaron los bigotes. {mouse:face happy} [whispers] —Seguidme. Mis bigotes notan el camino. {mouse:go to pond} {sfx:rustle} Y allá fue, pasito a pasito. {badger:go to pond} Tejón fue detrás de él. {raccoon:live peekaboo resume} Mapache se destapó los ojos —¡cucú, tras!— {raccoon:go to pond} y fue detrás de Tejón. {mouse:live sniff hold} De pronto, Ratón se paró de puntillas. —Aquí hay agua. ¡Vamos a rodearla! {mouse:live sniff resume} Y la rodearon en fila, nariz con cola. {canvas:clouds stop} Entonces la nube se apartó de la luna. {badger:face happy} {raccoon:face happy} [laughs] ¡Allí estaba la charca, justo a su lado, y ni una pata mojada! {mouse:hearts} Tejón {badger:live twitch-whiskers} movió sus propios bigotes. —La próxima vez —dijo—, lo pruebo yo.

ja-JP.title: ネズミくんに ついていこう
ja-JP.text: {canvas:night 0.7}{sfx:crickets}[softly]お月さまのあかりのなか、{badger:enter}アナグマくんと{raccoon:enter}{raccoon:go to badger}アライグマくんと、小さな{mouse:enter}{mouse:go to badger}ネズミくんが、のはらをかえっていきます。{canvas:clouds 0.8}ところが、大きなくもがお月さまをかくして、まっくら。{badger:face surprised}「なんにも見えない！」 とアナグマくん。{raccoon:live peekaboo hold}[giggles]「ぼくも！いないいない…」 とアライグマくんは、目をかくします。{badger:live scratch-head}「おうちはどっち？池はどこ？あしがぬれるのは、いやだなあ」 すると、{mouse:live twitch-whiskers}ネズミくんのひげが、ぴくぴくっ。{mouse:face happy}[whispers]「ついてきて。ひげで、みちがわかるんだ」 {mouse:go to pond}{sfx:rustle}ぴくぴく、そろりそろり。{badger:go to pond}アナグマくんが、のそのそつづきます。{raccoon:live peekaboo resume}「…ばあ！」 アライグマくんも{raccoon:go to pond}あとからのそのそ。{mouse:live sniff hold}とつぜん、ネズミくんがつまさきだちで、ぴたっ。「この先は水。こっちからまわろう！」 {mouse:live sniff resume}みんなで、はなとしっぽをくっつけて、ぐるっと。{canvas:clouds stop}やがて、くもがお月さまからはなれると…{badger:face happy}{raccoon:face happy}[laughs]池は、すぐとなり。ぬれたあしは、ひとつもありません！{mouse:hearts}アナグマくんは、{badger:live twitch-whiskers}じぶんのひげをぴくぴく。「こんどは、ぼくもためしてみよう」

de-DE.title: Die Maus zeigt den Weg
de-DE.text: {canvas:night 0.7} {sfx:crickets} [softly] Im Mondschein liefen {badger:enter} der Dachs, {raccoon:enter} {raccoon:go to badger} der Waschbär und die kleine {mouse:enter} {mouse:go to badger} Maus über die Wiese nach Hause. {canvas:clouds 0.8} Doch da schob sich eine große Wolke vor den Mond, und alles wurde dunkel. {badger:face surprised} „Ich sehe gar nichts!“, sagte der Dachs. {raccoon:live peekaboo hold} [giggles] „Ich auch nicht!“, sagte der Waschbär, die Pfoten vor den Augen. {badger:live scratch-head} „Wo geht’s nach Hause? Wo ist der Teich? Ich will keine nassen Pfoten!“ Da {mouse:live twitch-whiskers} zuckten der Maus die Schnurrhaare. {mouse:face happy} [whispers] „Mir nach. Meine Schnurrhaare fühlen den Weg.“ {mouse:go to pond} {sfx:rustle} Los tippelte sie, zuck, zuck, zuck. {badger:go to pond} Der Dachs tapste hinterher. {raccoon:live peekaboo resume} Der Waschbär nahm die Pfoten weg – „Kuckuck!“ – {raccoon:go to pond} und tapste dem Dachs nach. {mouse:live sniff hold} Plötzlich blieb die Maus stehen, ganz auf den Zehenspitzen. „Da vorne ist Wasser. Hier herum!“ {mouse:live sniff resume} Also gingen sie außen herum, im Gänsemarsch, Nase an Schwanz. {canvas:clouds stop} Dann zog die Wolke vom Mond weg. {badger:face happy} {raccoon:face happy} [laughs] Da lag der Teich, direkt neben ihnen – und keine einzige Pfote war nass! {mouse:hearts} Der Dachs {badger:live twitch-whiskers} wackelte mit seinen eigenen Schnurrhaaren. „Nächstes Mal“, sagte er, „probier ich das auch.“

fr-FR.title: Souris montre le chemin
fr-FR.text: {canvas:night 0.7} {sfx:crickets} [softly] Au clair de la lune, {badger:enter} Blaireau, {raccoon:enter} {raccoon:go to badger} Raton laveur et {mouse:enter} {mouse:go to badger} Souris rentraient chez eux par le pré. {canvas:clouds 0.8} Mais un gros nuage a glissé devant la lune, et il a fait tout noir. {badger:face surprised} « Je n’y vois rien ! » a dit Blaireau. {raccoon:live peekaboo hold} [giggles] « Moi non plus ! » a dit Raton laveur, les pattes sur les yeux. {badger:live scratch-head} « Où est la maison ? Et la mare ? Pas question de mouiller mes pattes ! » Alors {mouse:live twitch-whiskers} les moustaches de Souris ont frémi. {mouse:face happy} [whispers] « Suivez-moi. Mes moustaches sentent le chemin. » {mouse:go to pond} {sfx:rustle} Et la voilà partie, moustaches en avant. {badger:go to pond} Blaireau l’a suivie en traînant les pattes. {raccoon:live peekaboo resume} Raton laveur a ouvert les yeux — « Coucou ! » — {raccoon:go to pond} et a suivi Blaireau. {mouse:live sniff hold} Soudain, Souris s’est arrêtée, sur la pointe des pieds. « De l’eau, juste devant. On fait le tour par ici ! » {mouse:live sniff resume} Alors ils ont fait le tour, à la queue leu leu. {canvas:clouds stop} Puis le nuage s’est écarté de la lune. {badger:face happy} {raccoon:face happy} [laughs] La mare était là, juste à côté d’eux, et pas une seule patte mouillée ! {mouse:hearts} Blaireau {badger:live twitch-whiskers} a remué ses propres moustaches. « La prochaine fois, a-t-il dit, j’essaierai aussi. »

it-IT.title: Topolino fa strada
it-IT.text: {canvas:night 0.7} {sfx:crickets} [softly] Al chiaro di luna, {badger:enter} Tasso, {raccoon:enter} {raccoon:go to badger} Procione e il piccolo {mouse:enter} {mouse:go to badger} Topolino tornavano a casa attraverso il prato. {canvas:clouds 0.8} Ma una grossa nuvola ha coperto la luna, e tutto è diventato buio. {badger:face surprised} «Non vedo niente!» ha detto Tasso. {raccoon:live peekaboo hold} [giggles] «Neanch'io!» ha detto Procione, con le zampe sugli occhi. {badger:live scratch-head} «Da che parte è casa? E lo stagno dov'è? Non voglio bagnarmi le zampe!» Allora {mouse:live twitch-whiskers} i baffi di Topolino hanno cominciato a vibrare. {mouse:face happy} [whispers] «Seguitemi. I miei baffi sentono la strada.» {mouse:go to pond} {sfx:rustle} E via, piano piano, coi baffi che fremevano. {badger:go to pond} Tasso gli è andato dietro. {raccoon:live peekaboo resume} Procione ha sbirciato — «Cucù… settete!» — {raccoon:go to pond} e ha seguito Tasso. {mouse:live sniff hold} All'improvviso Topolino si è fermato, in punta di piedi. «Acqua, proprio qui davanti. Giriamo di qua!» {mouse:live sniff resume} E hanno fatto il giro, in fila indiana, naso contro coda. {canvas:clouds stop} Poi la nuvola è scivolata via dalla luna. {badger:face happy} {raccoon:face happy} [laughs] Ed ecco lo stagno, proprio lì accanto, e nemmeno una zampa bagnata! {mouse:hearts} Tasso {badger:live twitch-whiskers} ha mosso i suoi baffi. «La prossima volta», ha detto, «ci provo anch'io.»

zh-TW.title: 小老鼠帶路
zh-TW.text: {canvas:night 0.7}{sfx:crickets}[softly]月光下，{badger:enter}獾、{raccoon:enter}{raccoon:go to badger}浣熊和{mouse:enter}{mouse:go to badger}小老鼠，正穿過草地走回家。{canvas:clouds 0.8}可是，一大片雲飄過來，把月亮遮住了，四周一下子暗了下來。{badger:face surprised}「我什麼都看不見！」 獾說。{raccoon:live peekaboo hold}[giggles]「我也是！」 浣熊說，牠正用手掌蒙著眼睛呢。{badger:live scratch-head}「家在哪一邊？ 池塘在哪裡？我可不想把腳弄濕！」 這時，{mouse:live twitch-whiskers}小老鼠的鬍鬚動了動。{mouse:face happy}[whispers]「跟我來。我的鬍鬚摸得出路。」 {mouse:go to pond}{sfx:rustle}牠輕輕地往前走，鬍鬚抖抖抖，抖抖抖。{badger:go to pond}獾慢吞吞地跟在牠後面。{raccoon:live peekaboo resume}浣熊偷偷一看——「哇，看到了！」——{raccoon:go to pond}也跟在獾的後面。{mouse:live sniff hold}突然，小老鼠停下來，踮起腳尖。「前面有水。從這邊繞過去！」 {mouse:live sniff resume}於是大家一個跟著一個，鼻子貼著尾巴，繞了過去。{canvas:clouds stop}這時，雲飄走了，月亮又露出臉來。{badger:face happy}{raccoon:face happy}[laughs]池塘就在旁邊，可是沒有一隻腳弄濕！{mouse:hearts}獾{badger:live twitch-whiskers}也動了動自己的鬍鬚。「下一次，」 牠說，「我也來試試看。」

zh-HK.title: 小老鼠帶路
zh-HK.text: {canvas:night 0.7}{sfx:crickets}[softly]月光下，{badger:enter}獾、{raccoon:enter}{raccoon:go to badger}浣熊，還有{mouse:enter}{mouse:go to badger}小老鼠，正穿過草地回家去。{canvas:clouds 0.8}可是一大朵雲慢慢飄過來，遮住了月亮，四周一下子變得黑麻麻。{badger:face surprised}「我乜都睇唔到呀！」 獾說。{raccoon:live peekaboo hold}[giggles]「我都係！」 浣熊用手掩住眼睛說。{badger:live scratch-head}「返屋企行邊條路㗎？池塘喺邊呀？我唔想濕腳呀！」 這時，{mouse:live twitch-whiskers}小老鼠的鬍鬚抖了抖。{mouse:face happy}[whispers]「跟住我。我啲鬚摸得出條路。」 {mouse:go to pond}{sfx:rustle}牠輕手輕腳地向前走，鬍鬚抖呀抖，抖呀抖。{badger:go to pond}獾慢慢地跟在後面。{raccoon:live peekaboo resume}浣熊打開雙手偷看——「見到喇！」——{raccoon:go to pond}也跟在獾的後面。{mouse:live sniff hold}突然，小老鼠停下來，踮起腳尖。「前面有水。行呢邊，兜過去！」 {mouse:live sniff resume}於是大家一個跟一個，鼻子貼着尾巴，兜了過去。{canvas:clouds stop}這時，雲飄走了，月亮又出來了。{badger:face happy}{raccoon:face happy}[laughs]原來池塘就在大家旁邊，可是沒有一隻腳弄濕！{mouse:hearts}獾{badger:live twitch-whiskers}也抖抖自己的鬍鬚。「下次，」 牠說，「我都要試吓。」

crickets.prompt: gentle night crickets in a summer meadow, very calm and soft, realistic field recording

rustle.prompt: small animals padding softly through grass and ferns at night, gentle rustle, realistic
